mapper.insert: insert into dependent (employee_id, full_name, relationship, tax_code, start_date, end_date, status) values (#{employeeId}, #{fullName}, #{relationship}, #{taxCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: update dependent set status = #{status} where dependent_id = #{dependentId}
mapper.select: select dependent_id as dependentId, employee_id as employeeId, full_name as fullName, relationship as relationship, tax_code as taxCode, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, status as status, created_at as createdAt from dependent where employee_id = #{employeeId} order by status desc, dependent_id desc
select count(*) from dependent where employee_id = #{employeeId} and status = 1
